dek: WeChat has started gray-testing Xiaowei, a native AI assistant embedded inside the app, powered by WeLM, the WeChat AI team's long-developed large language model. WeLM has moved to sparse MoE architecture, with a 617-billion-parameter version activating just 23 billion per token, and the team is exploring Hidden Decodi
